entities.title: Reducing Visa Appointment Wait Times for Pakistani People
entities.summary: The U.S. Mission to Pakistan is working to reduce visa appointment wait times by expediting non-immigrant visa appointments, allowing applicants to rebook appointments at different locations, and accepting new interview waiver applications.
important_notes: Applicants can check their eligibility for interview waiver applications on ustraveldocs.com/pk
